name: subagent-team
description: Run coding work as a team: a director session, manager and worker subagents, outsourced CLI agents (agy, Codex CLI), independent read-only reviewers, and resumable handover.

interface.shortDescription: Run coding work as a team of subagents and external CLI agents
interface.longDescription: A director session splits and integrates; manager subagents design, review and accept; worker subagents and outsourced CLI agents (agy, Codex CLI) implement; the human gets one batched question list at the end.
